trust_decision.summary: User-supplied contract options (name, uri) are treated as data and must be emitted as correctly escaped string literals when the wizard generates Solidity/TypeScript test files (and, via the shared helper, Solidity contract source); decided at each code-generation template site in packages/core/solidity.

landing_point.why: Summary names 'generated Hardhat and Foundry tests' and opts.name/opts.uri; grepping opts.name lands on the raw template literals in zip-hardhat.ts getExpects and zip-foundry.ts getContractSpecificTestFunction.

fix_sites.entry_point: public npm export @openzeppelin/wizard/zip-env-hardhat zipHardhat(c, opts) (packages/core/solidity/zip-env-hardhat.ts); UI 'Download Hardhat' packages/ui/src/solidity/App.svelte:208; also inherited by zipHardhatPolkadot packages/core/solidity/src/zip-hardhat-polkadot.ts:84-85
fix_sites.module_kind: code generator (TypeScript/Chai test template), base class reused by Polkadot wrapper

fix_sites.entry_point: public npm export @openzeppelin/wizard/zip-env-foundry zipFoundry(c, opts); UI 'Download Foundry' packages/ui/src/solidity/App.svelte:220

printContract -> printValue (packages/core/solidity/src/print.ts:247) for every string constructor arg (ERC20/721/1155 name, symbol, uri, Governor name); reached by public print APIs, UI, MCP; and newly by zip-foundry.ts test template in the fix (fix.diff:607)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: packages/core/solidity/src/utils/sanitize.ts:5 (stringifyUnicodeSafe, used by packages/core/solidity/src/print.ts:247): unicode branch escapes only '"', not backslash/CR/LF/VT, so a non-ASCII name containing a backslash-quote breaks out of the contract's own unicode"..." literal; the fix rewrote it (fix.diff:90-103)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about generated test files; the contract printer already 'sanitizes' strings via stringifyUnicodeSafe (escapes quotes, JSON.stringify for ASCII), so a solver sees an existing defence in print.ts and leaves the helper alone, or reuses it as-is in the test templates.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Unicode names/URIs must still emit unicode"..." literals with raw non-ASCII/non-BMP characters (no surrogate escapes), ASCII names must stay plain "..." literals, ERC1155 '{id}' placeholder must survive, and generated snapshots/compile tests must keep passing; over-broad fixes (rejecting quotes, stripping non-ASCII, JSON.stringify into Solidity which emits \b/\f/\u escapes and raw unicode in a non-unicode literal) break compiling projects.

O6_input_shapes: non-ASCII string with backslash + quote (unicode branch breakout, fix.diff:29-31)
non-BMP, DEL, NUL, backspace passed raw (fix.diff:34-53)
two target languages: Solidity literal (stringifyUnicodeSafe) vs TypeScript literal (JSON.stringify) (fix.diff:607, fix.diff:833)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: c.license is interpolated raw into the header comment of the generated Foundry test and script files (newline in license injects Solidity lines into test/*.t.sol and script/*.s.sol)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Report names only opts.name/opts.uri; license is an 'info' option in a comment, not a string literal assertion.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as fix site, different field (packages/core/solidity/src/set-info.ts:21-22 sets it)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Same raw c.license into the SPDX comment of the generated contract source included in every zip (and printContract output)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Contract printer, not test generation; comment field; the license is meant to be free-form SPDX text.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file (print.ts) from landing point, same package

O8_uncovered_routes.route: securityContact passed raw into a NatSpec tag of the generated contract (only key is validated)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different option (info), natspec comment, addNatspecTag validates the key so it looks 'already handled' (packages/core/solidity/src/contract.ts:203).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: two files from landing point (set-info.ts -> contract.ts -> print.ts:43)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ERC721 baseUri emitted with JSON.stringify into a Solidity return literal instead of stringifyUnicodeSafe; a variant using raw "${baseUri}" would be a realistic sibling inside contract source.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Maintainers already hand-roll literal emission per option here rather than going through printValue.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Stellar Rust test template builds String::from_str(&env, "${c.name}"); switching it to the token's display name (opts.name) would mirror the Solidity bug in a second implementation in another package.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The Rust test asserts client.name() equals a string literal, exactly the shape of the Solidity testName assertion; c.name is currently an identifier so it is safe today.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A Polkadot-specific getTest override with its own expect(...).to.equal("${opts.name}") would be a wrapper-level copy the base-class fix does not reach.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The Polkadot generator already overrides config/package methods of HardhatZipGenerator; overriding the test template is a natural extension.

O9_family: code injection / improper neutralization in generated source (CWE-94, string-literal escaping across two target languages)

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js + yarn workspaces, ts compile, AVA tests with snapshots
O10_build.project_tests: packages/core/solidity/src/utils/sanitize.test.ts (unit), zip-hardhat.test.ts and zip-foundry.test.ts (snapshot tests; their compile/run parts invoke npm ci / forge and need network/toolchains, but snapshot generation is offline)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap opts.name/opts.uri in JSON.stringify (or the existing stringifyUnicodeSafe) in both test templates and stop, leaving the helper's unicode-branch backslash/newline breakout open and emitting JSON escapes that are invalid in Solidity.

out_of_scope_notes: Confidential zipHardhat passes no opts so getExpects emits nothing (packages/core/confidential/src/zip-hardhat.ts:32-33); not a route.
set-namespaced-storage interpolates namespacePrefix into a // comment but rejects whitespace (packages/core/solidity/src/set-namespaced-storage.ts:9,33-35).
